purpose: Teach: 右足/ピル/人妻/男児/牙/疾走/歓喜/先導

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、右足に踏ん張りが利くシューズを開発しろ
lines.en: Develop a shoe for our company that gives the right foot better grip and stability.
lines.style: Direct command, clipped pacing. Measured authority — not rushed, but decisive. Weight on the business logic, not emotion. Clear eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の健康相談、ピル等も含め対応します
lines.en: Understood. I'll handle employee health support, including contraception and related care.
lines.style: Focused, professional acknowledgment. Steady pace. Taking mental notes — not rushed, but comprehensive. Slight nod of confirmation in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の人妻、つまり既婚女性社員を支援しろ
lines.en: Support our married female employees — ensure they have what they need.
lines.style: Firm instruction, no hedging. Deliberate pacing. Brief pause before the expectation lands. Matter-of-fact but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。男児育児休暇を取得しやすくします
lines.en: Understood. I'll make it easier for fathers to take childcare leave.
lines.style: Assured response. Steady, capable tone. Shows he's already thinking it through. No hesitation, just clear intent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合の牙、つまり脅威を分析しろ
lines.en: Analyze our competition — identify the threats we're facing.
lines.style: Sharp, focused command. Slight lean into the urgency without raising volume. Analytical edge — this is strategy, not sentiment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場を疾走するスピード経営を目指します
lines.en: Understood. We'll pursue rapid, aggressive market positioning.
lines.style: Confident acknowledgment. Slightly faster pace than before — energy rising. Shows alignment with the strategic vision. Professional momentum.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に歓喜の瞬間を提供しろ
lines.en: Ensure our employees experience moments of genuine satisfaction and pride.
lines.style: Measured command with underlying warmth. Slower than the previous directives. Weight on the human outcome, not just the business. Deliberate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の先導役を担います
lines.en: Understood. We'll take the lead in our industry.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Grounded, settled tone. Slight rise of conviction at the end — this is the closing promise. Respectful but resolute.
